sentence: This project develops an injectable biomaterial that tries to help brain tissue regrow and recover function after stroke.
This project uses machine learning on data from wearable technology to detect complications after heart and lung surgery and predict recovery.
This project builds a core that uses machine learning and deep learning on genomic, imaging and clinical data to find therapeutic targets.
This project offers a shared resource that helps researchers design and screen small molecules as probes of tumor growth pathways.
This project tries to predict which drug reduces heavy drinking and which behavioral treatment prevents relapse in alcohol use disorder.
This project provides a core with tools for auditory and vestibular research, using imaging and mass spectrometry in mouse and zebrafish models.
This project studies how mitochondria in skeletal muscle are regulated and how they contribute to type 2 diabetes.
This project tests targeted gene therapy to remove HIV reservoirs and neuroinflammation in the brain of rhesus macaques exposed to methamphetamine.
This project runs a data bank that shares magnetic resonance data on protein and nucleic acid structures, metabolites and disease biomarkers.
This project studies the genetic mechanisms that link aging to cancer, including tumor growth, immune dysfunction and resistance to treatment.
This project builds models that link biological scales to study infectious and immune-mediated disease and guide public health decisions.
This project provides analysis and CRISPR screening support to find molecular drivers of prostate cancer lineage plasticity and develop biomarkers.
This project combines two magnetic resonance methods to measure true temperature across the brain with fine detail in space and time.
This project uses data to estimate how often a genetic variant causes disease, instead of sorting variants into fixed classes.
This project develops artificial intelligence tools that combine clinical, imaging and genomic data to find disease-causing genetic variants in congenital heart disease.
This project studies how sphingolipid levels affect mitochondria so they keep working in aging cells.
This project builds a programmable platform to show how mRNA affects cellular differentiation over time.
This project studies how abnormal Tau changes brain circuit function in mouse models of Progressive Supranuclear Palsy.
This project tests combined gene therapy and chemotherapy, delivered by inhalation and aimed at lung cancer cells, to treat lung cancer.
This project tests whether CRISPR gene editing delivered by a virus is effective and safe for treating Huntington's disease in animal models.
